title: Aperture Healthcare POC - Security Evidence Manifest
body:
Purpose:
This manifest collects the answers, artifacts, and workshop outputs produced for the Aperture Healthcare POC (Nov–Dec 2025). It is intended to be the single index we hand to their InfoSec team for audit review and to track outstanding evidence items during the next 2 weeks.

Scope and audience:
- Scope: Hosted Redwood inference usage for patient triage assistant (non-PHI tokenization flows) and Dedicated deployment for secure processing of de-identified datasets.
- Audience: Aperture technical security reviewers, Redwood SEs & SREs, Compliance reviewer.

Engagement summary (high level):
- Kickoff: 2025-11-11, initial questionnaire received (Aperture-Sec-Q1.pdf).
- Workshop: Security deep-dive and evidence triage on 2025-11-18 (remote, 90m). Notes below.
- Evidence staging: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/aperture-healthcare/poc-2025 on 2025-11-24.

Workshop notes (11/18/2025):
Attendees: Priya Menon (Redwood SE), Carlos Gutierrez (Redwood SRE), Elena Park (Redwood Security), Dr. Hari Patel (Aperture CTO), Serena Cho (Aperture InfoSec)
Key discussion points:
- Encryption in transit & at rest: clarified TLS termination (edge), internal mTLS between control plane and runtime, and customer KMS integration for Dedicated deployments.
- Data classification: Aperture confirmed they will not send direct PHI during POC; they will use realistic synthetic records that follow PHI patterns.
- Audit logs: demonstrated console-level audit trails and tokenized request logs with redaction.
- HSM/KMS: discussed KMS integration options: Redwood-managed KMS for Hosted and BYOK via customer KMS for Dedicated/Private.
- Network isolation: options for VPC peering versus private connectors covered; recommended private deployment for production regulated workloads.

Questionnaire highlights (summary of RFI responses):
- Q: Where are logs stored and for how long?
  A: Logs retained in our central logging cluster (Elasticsearch-compatible) for 90 days by default; can be extended per contract. Audit trail export available to customer S3 bucket via delivery pipeline (see artifact: audit-log-export-runbook.pdf).
- Q: Who has administrative access?
  A: RBAC enforced through our console + SSO (OIDC/SAML). Admins limited by role; SRE emergency access is time-bound with just-in-time approval (recorded in PAM).
- Q: Is there an incident response plan?
  A: Yes — Redwood IR runbook (artifact: ir-runbook-2025-07.pdf) and contact SOC playbook included.

Evidence inventory (staged artifacts):
1) infra/hosted/tls-certs-and-termination.png — diagram of TLS termination points and mTLS flows.
2) infra/dedicated/kyc-byok-kms-arch.pdf — BYOK integration diagram and key lifecycle notes.
3) logs/audit-log-export-runbook.pdf — S3 export job, retention, and sample manifest.
4) controls/rbac-role-matrix.csv — role -> permission mapping (console + API).
5) controls/pam-approval-records-sample.txt — redacted JIT SRE access log snippet.
6) compliance/soc2-snapshot-2025-06.pdf — SOC2 snapshot summary + scope statement (redacted).
7) compliance/iso-gap-analysis-aperture-2025.xlsx — ISO27001 mapping used during workshop.
8) deployment/private-networking-checklist.md — steps and commands used for VPC setup in the Dedicated trial.
9) tests/pen-test-summary-2024-11.pdf — third-party pentest executive summary and remediation status.
10) artifacts/hosted-config-logging-sample.json — sample of request-level metadata (PII redacted).

How artifacts are organized in S3:
- s3://redwood-evidence/aperture-healthcare/poc-2025/infra/
- s3://redwood-evidence/aperture-healthcare/poc-2025/controls/
- s3://redwood-evidence/aperture-healthcare/poc-2025/compliance/
- s3://redwood-evidence/aperture-healthcare/poc-2025/tests/
Note: objects in the bucket are ACL-restricted; we shared time-limited signed URLs with Aperture InfoSec (see linked_artifacts).

Evidence retrieval commands (for SE/SREs):
- aws s3 ls s3://redwood-evidence/aperture-healthcare/poc-2025/ --profile redwood-sec
- aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evidence/aperture-healthcare/poc-2025/controls/rbac-role-matrix.csv ./ --region us-west-2 --profile redwood-sec

Outstanding gaps and action items (owner + ETA):
- G1: Signed AIA (Acceptable InfoSec Agreement) from Aperture legal outstanding. Owner: Priya Menon. ETA: 2025-12-07. Jira: JIRA-SE-4187.
- G2: Provide HSM attestation excerpt for BYOK flow. Owner: Elena Park. ETA: 2025-12-05. Artifact planned: hsm-attestation-excerpt.pdf
- G3: Redaction proof for sample logs (showing PHI redaction automated rules). Owner: Carlos Gutierrez. ETA: 2025-12-02. Linked ticket: JIRA-SRE-902.
- G4: Provide SLA and Dedicated capacity isolation appendix for healthcare deployments. Owner: Priya Menon. ETA: 2025-12-09.

Risk notes and mitigations:
- Risk: Customer may accidentally send PHI during POC testing.
  Mitigation: mandatory synthetic-record gating in onboarding template; automated content detection with client-side SDK warnings (see artifact: onboarding-template-v2.md).
- Risk: Ambiguity about log retention settings for trial vs contracted.
  Mitigation: default 90-day retention, documented export to customer-owned S3 and contract clause for retention extension.

Packaging checklist (what we will deliver to Aperture InfoSec as a single bundle):
- Consolidated PDF (this manifest + embedded artifacts)
- S3 export with signed URLs (valid 14 days) and a verification checksum file (sha256sum.txt)
- Redaction demonstration video (short screen capture of console where sample request is redacted)
- Contact list for technical follow-ups (SE, SRE, Security)

Notes to SEs (practical):
- When sharing signed URLs, always use internal ticket reference in the email subject (Aperture-SEC-JIRA-SE-4187) so the compliance team can correlate.
- For any new artifact uploaded to the s3 bucket, add an index entry in controls/manifest-index.csv and notify Elena for final attestation.

Signoffs required before final delivery:
- Redwood Security: Elena Park (pending HSM attestation)
- Redwood SRE: Carlos Gutierrez (pending log-redaction proof)
- Redwood Solutions: Priya Menon (AIA and SLA appendix)

Next steps (timeline):
- 2025-12-02: Carlos upload log redaction proof (JIRA-SRE-902).
- 2025-12-03: Internal packaging review and generate consolidated PDF.
- 2025-12-05: Elena attach HSM attestation excerpt.
- 2025-12-07: Priya confirm AIA signed by Aperture legal.
- 2025-12-09: Final bundle delivered and handoff meeting scheduled.

Appendix: quick references
- Contact: priya.menon@redwood.ai, carlos.gutierrez@redwood.ai, elena.park@redwood.ai
- Related Confluence: Aperture POC onboarding (see linked_artifacts)

Draft notes / unresolved questions (raw):
- Serena asked if Dedicated would require a separate SOC2 scope; we need to confirm with compliance team (Elena to confirm with compliance).
- Need to verify whether the sample pentest includes red-team NW-layer tests (Carlos to follow-up).

This document is a working manifest and will be converted to the final evidence packet once all signoffs are complete.
